protocol.ensemble: arithmetic mean of all three best.pt scores; no seed selection
protocol.selection: first instances per size in fixed prepared-data order; never filter by outcome
protocol.parent_selection: lowest mean discovery gap-to-reference percent; ties keep earlier parent
protocol.elite_selection: top four unique valid programs including initial by discovery gap; select lowest mean program_select gap; ties prefer earlier candidate
protocol.failed_output: counts against output budget; no replacement; worst score; preserve raw output/error
protocol.duplicate_output: counts against output budget; exact canonical-program hash; reuse exact same-pool result and record reference
protocol.feedback: A endpoint only; B same endpoint fields plus predicted same-bank-state parent/child decision values; two examples of largest absolute predicted delta; no true probe labels in either prompt
protocol.feedback_confidence: always describe as provisional; show across-model std and action coverage; no asserted preference if abs(delta) <= max(0.001 pp, paired ensemble std)
protocol.expansion_gate: after first closed loop, finish only the predeclared 64-output small study if <7200s projected and all encoding/isolation/security checks pass; stop on severe probe mismatch (>=4 nonzero measured pairs and >50% opposite predicted signs above uncertainty threshold); never expand to 240 in this stage
protocol.stop_after_small_study: no further candidates on weak or negative B outcome; retain all negative results
